summary:
Comprehensive enhancement plan for the Transformed User Journey experience:
1. Re-order sections so the Interactive Journey Simulation Theater comes first, followed by the Technical Solution Mechanics architecture.
2. Transform the simulator into an eventful, high-impact split-screen live console featuring:
   - Dynamic realistic corporate customer records with live financial math (San Miguel Power ₱14.8M / Universal Robina ₱4.12M / Nestle PH ₱8.9M / BDO Unibank ₱6.4M).
   - Split-screen live ERP comparison showing real-time animated state transitions in Microsoft Dynamics NAV 2016 (Ledger Entry, Unapplied AR balance, BIR 2307 2% CWT calculation, and journal batch posting).
   - Rich interactive step trigger with step-by-step state visualization (Document Ingestion & OCR confidence, 3-Way Match discrepancy resolution, Supervisor Gate approval, and NAV 2016 Sync & Dispatch).
   - Live elapsed-time stopwatch comparison (e.g. 18.0 mins manual legacy vs 1.2 mins automated To-Be).
3. Position the 3-Layer Solution Architecture immediately following the interactive simulator to ground the demonstrated mechanics in enterprise architecture.
